## 🚀 Feature Request

### 📝 Describe your request

Let us know what exciting new feature you'd love to see on the website. Give us all the details! 🌟

### 🎯 Expected behavior

Tell us what you imagine this feature will do and how it will improve the website experience. Be as clear as possible.

### 📸 Screenshots

If you have any mockups or screenshots to show what you're thinking, feel free to share them here!

### 🔍 Additional context

Got any other thoughts or context to add about this feature? Share them here! 💡

### 📅 Due Date

Do you have any particular due date for this request?
